hero.subtitle: **Electrical Engineering in Switzerland for Indian Students**

overview:
In Switzerland, the Indian students studying Electrical Engineering get to learn about electrical circuits, power systems, electronics, control engineering, telecommunications and renewable energy technologies. Swiss engineering schools combine scientific basics with hands-on projects and research, preparing students for careers in the energy, automation, electronics and advanced technology industries.

Students who want to **study Electrical Engineering in Switzerland** can find a variety of programs and specializations at Swiss institutions.

In Switzerland a Bachelor in Electrical Engineering is usually about three years at many schools. However, program duration and structure differ and most bachelor programs are taught predominantly in German or French. Indian applicants must make sure that the Class 12 qualifications are in line with the requirements of the institution.

Important: there are few fully English-taught bachelor’s programs in electrical engineering in Switzerland. Before applying, check the medium of instruction, acceptability of Indian school qualifications and any entrance examination requirements.

**Electrical Engineering in Switzerland for Indian Students** offers opportunities to explore technical education, research and career pathways in several engineering fields. **Edu-Hawk Worldwide** can help students understand available study options and application requirements.

faq.question: Bachelor’s in Electrical Engineering in Switzerland duration?
faq.answer: Most full-time programs are three years (6 semesters) and have a total of 180 ECTS credits. The length of the study depends on the university and the form of study.

faq.question: Is it possible for Indian students to study Electrical Engineering in Switzerland after Class 12?
faq.answer: Indian students can apply if their school leaving qualifications meet the admission requirements of the university. Some institutions may require additional exams or qualifications.

faq.question: Do you need IELTS for Electrical Engineering in Switzerland?
faq.answer: Not necessarily so. Many bachelor’s programs are taught mainly in German or French, so proficiency in the relevant language may be required instead. Always check the language rules of the specific program.

faq.question: Are there bachelor’s programs in Electrical Engineering in Switzerland that are taught in English?
faq.answer: There are few full English taught options. Some universities do offer individual English-language modules or international study profiles, but German or French may still be required for the main bachelor’s program.

faq.question: What to do after Bachelor’s in Electrical Engineering in Switzerland?
faq.answer: You can pursue further education or a career in electrical design, power systems, electronics, embedded systems, automation, telecommunications, and renewable energy. Your employment depends on your qualifications, experience, language skills and work authorization.
